TestEveryPluginTablesRegistrationMatchesTheLiveSchema calls engine.BootstrapScratchDB directly (no t.Run dialect loop, so it skips under its own bare name), and BootstrapScratchDB is PostgreSQL-only -- the test exists to check admin.plugin_tables' tenant_scoped flag against information_schema.columns, a registry that only exists on PostgreSQL (see the test's own doc comment). multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and no postgres DSN at all, so it skips as "nothing configured", not a connection failure.
same test, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above; multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and no postgres DSN.
